description: This file contains data models and event handling logic for Grok Voice Agent API communication, including classes for audio formats, turn detection, session properties, conversation items, and server/client events, primarily using Pydantic models.

classes.name: AudioFormat
classes.description: Base class for audio format configuration.

classes.name: PCMAudioFormat
classes.description: PCM audio format configuration with configurable sample rate.

classes.name: PCMUAudioFormat
classes.description: PCMU (G.711 μ-law) audio format configuration.

classes.name: PCMAAudioFormat
classes.description: PCMA (G.711 A-law) audio format configuration.

classes.name: TurnDetection
classes.description: Server-side voice activity detection configuration.

classes.name: AudioInput
classes.description: Audio input configuration.

classes.name: AudioOutput
classes.description: Audio output configuration.

classes.name: AudioConfiguration
classes.description: Audio configuration for input and output.

classes.name: WebSearchTool
classes.description: Web search tool configuration for Grok.

classes.name: XSearchTool
classes.description: X (Twitter) search tool configuration for Grok.

classes.name: FileSearchTool
classes.description: File/Collection search tool configuration for Grok.

classes.name: FunctionTool
classes.description: Custom function tool configuration.

classes.name: SessionProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties for a Grok Voice Agent session.

classes.name: ItemContent
classes.description: Content within a conversation item.

classes.name: ConversationItem
classes.description: A conversation item in the realtime session.

classes.name: RealtimeConversation
classes.description: A realtime conversation session.

classes.name: ResponseProperties
classes.description: Properties for configuring assistant responses.

classes.name: RealtimeError
classes.description: Error information from the realtime API.

classes.name: ClientEvent
classes.description: Base class for client events sent to Grok.

classes.name: SessionUpdateEvent
classes.description: Event to update session properties.

classes.name: InputAudioBufferAppendEvent
classes.description: Event to append audio data to the input buffer.

classes.name: InputAudioBufferCommitEvent
classes.description: Event to commit the current input audio buffer.

classes.name: InputAudioBufferClearEvent
classes.description: Event to clear the input audio buffer.

classes.name: ConversationItemCreateEvent
classes.description: Event to create a new conversation item.

classes.name: ResponseCreateEvent
classes.description: Event to create a new assistant response.

classes.name: ResponseCancelEvent
classes.description: Event to cancel the current assistant response.

classes.name: ServerEvent
classes.description: Base class for server events received from the realtime API.

classes.name: SessionUpdatedEvent
classes.description: Event indicating a session has been updated.

classes.name: ConversationCreated
classes.description: Event indicating a conversation has been created.

classes.name: ConversationItemAdded
classes.description: Event indicating a conversation item has been added.

classes.name: ConversationItemInputAudioTranscriptionCompleted
classes.description: Event indicating input audio transcription is complete.

classes.name: InputAudioBufferSpeechStarted
classes.description: Event indicating speech has started in the input audio buffer.

classes.name: InputAudioBufferSpeechStopped
classes.description: Event indicating speech has stopped in the input audio buffer.

classes.name: InputAudioBufferCommitted
classes.description: Event indicating the input audio buffer has been committed.

classes.name: InputAudioBufferCleared
classes.description: Event indicating the input audio buffer has been cleared.

classes.name: ResponseCreated
classes.description: Event indicating an assistant response has been created.

classes.name: ResponseOutputItemAdded
classes.description: Event indicating an output item has been added to a response.

classes.name: ResponseAudioTranscriptDelta
classes.description: Event containing incremental audio transcript from a response.

classes.name: ResponseAudioTranscriptDone
classes.description: Event indicating audio transcript is complete.

classes.name: ResponseAudioDelta
classes.description: Event containing incremental audio data from a response.

classes.name: ResponseFunctionCallArgumentsDelta
classes.description: Event containing incremental function call arguments.

classes.name: ResponseFunctionCallArgumentsDone
classes.description: Event indicating function call arguments are complete.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: Token usage statistics for a response.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A complete assistant response.

classes.name: ResponseDone
classes.description: Event indicating an assistant response is complete.

classes.name: ResponseOutputItemDone
classes.description: Event indicating an output item is complete.

classes.name: ContentPart
classes.description: A content part within a response.

classes.name: ResponseContentPartAdded
classes.description: Event indicating a content part has been added to a response.

classes.name: ResponseContentPartDone
classes.description: Event indicating a content part is complete.

classes.name: PingEvent
classes.description: Keep-alive ping event from the server.

classes.name: ErrorEvent
classes.description: Event indicating an error occurred.

classes.name: parse_server_event
classes.description: Function to parse a server event from JSON string.

methods.name: parse_server_event
methods.description: Parse a server event from JSON string.
